findings.evidence: MainViewModel+Concerts.kt:30-41: LocationManager obtains current device location (latitude, longitude) via FusedLocationProviderClient when user initiates concert search or navigates to Concerts screen, and passes lat/lon to Firebase Cloud Function searchConcerts.
findings.recommendation: Declare approximate location collection in the Play Store Data Safety form under App Functionality.

findings.evidence: MainViewModel.kt:974-1008: AudioDeviceInfo is inspected locally via AudioManager.getDevices to determine audio output types (speaker, bluetooth headset) for on-device UI rendering. No device hardware identifiers are collected or transmitted off-device.
findings.recommendation: No action required as device audio output info is processed locally on-device.

findings.evidence: FakeHeartRateData.kt:21-199: Hardcoded mock heart rate data heartRateGraphData is used exclusively for Jetpack Compose UI sample previews. No actual fitness or health data is collected or transmitted off-device.
findings.recommendation: No action required as heart rate data consists of hardcoded mock samples used strictly for local UI layout previews.
